reason: Fresh OSS-first prerequisite for Product Experience PR #229 and future packaged Windows runtimes. The repository requires Node >=22.19.0 and Product Final Validation already uses pinned Node 22.23.1, but the existing WP7 packaged-runtime identity still defaults to Node 22.16.0 and packaged Electron passes that bundled runtime directly to Letta Code. The formal Windows Builder also conflates its build-host Node/npm toolchain with the Node executable embedded into the product. This package separates those custodians without expanding into an unrelated npm/release-toolchain migration: official Node 22.23.1 becomes the single packaged-runtime authority, the Builder keeps its independently reviewed build-host Node/npm custody, and it receives a separately verified trusted runtime executable for embedding. The failure-first test is placed under the permanent WP0 suite so the first implementation commit produces a real remote Stage causal RED before production changes. No Product-specific runtime, downloader, package manager, runtime manager, dependency or lockfile change is authorized.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Require exact repository-relative normalized paths, discard invalid paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().
digestCanonicalization.canonicalText: Join the normalized sorted unique path list with LF and append exactly one trailing LF before hashing.

retireOrAvoid: Retire Node 22.16.0 as the packaged resources/runtime/node22 authority and final packaged-runtime evidence value.
Retire the Builder assumption that build-host process.execPath must also be the product-embedded trusted runtime; use an explicit trusted-node input through the existing Builder seam.
Avoid any Product-specific Node runtime/version override or second runtime resolver.
Avoid any Yance Node downloader, runtime manager, package manager, or user-machine Node/npm/node-gyp/Visual Studio/Windows SDK/Spectre prerequisite.

retirementRules: Retire Node 22.16.0 from the packaged runtime identity and packaged-runtime evidence while preserving historical evidence and archived closure documents.
Do not upgrade or broaden the formal build-host npm toolchain in this package; build-host package-manager custody remains separately governed and is not the Product UAT blocker.
Legacy source-UAT and Batch40 acceptance artifacts are not repaired here because the next Product materialized-UAT work package must retire user-machine build routes rather than prolong them.
Do not add a second Product Experience Node authority or version override path around tools/wp7/node-runtime-identity.js.
Do not make npm 10.9.8 a repository package-manager authority merely because it is bundled in the official Node archive; repository dependency installation remains governed separately by npm@10.9.2.
mandatoryFailureFirstContracts: On the exact authorization-merge baseline, tests/wp0/v21-trusted-node-runtime-authority.test.js must be the only implementation change and Stage npm run test:wp0 must fail causally because tools/wp7/node-runtime-identity.js and packaged-runtime evidence still declare Node 22.16.0 and the formal Builder still embeds process.execPath instead of a separately supplied trusted runtime executable.
The focused test must prove the packaged trusted Node authority is exactly 22.23.1 and satisfies the repository Node >=22.19.0 floor.
The PowerShell Builder wrapper must keep reviewed build-host Node/npm custody separate, require an explicit trusted runtime Node executable, and pass it to run-windows-final-builder.js.

run-windows-final-builder.js must embed the explicit trusted runtime executable instead of process.execPath; missing or wrong-version trusted runtime input must fail closed through the existing WP7 runtime authority.
The final packaged-runtime evidence validator, shared WP7 fixture and Windows network-isolation smoke contract must converge on Node 22.23.1.
Packaged Electron must continue to resolve the one existing resources/runtime/node22 authority; no Product-specific path or alternate runtime resolver may be introduced.
Historical evidence and legacy source-UAT/Batch40 artifacts are not rewritten; they are handed to the next materialized-UAT retirement package.

downstreamBoundary.rule: Only after this authorization and its implementation ordinary-merge to main may a separate fresh-main OSS-fit authorization be created for Product materialized UAT. The downstream package must retire legacy source-UAT/user-machine build routes rather than update their Node version.
